name: protforge
description: 23 computational-biology skills across three runtimes: prebuilt Docker containers (docking, pockets, MD, sequence design, epitopes, ADMET, antibody folding, RFdiffusion backbones), WSL-hosted models (ESMFold2, OpenDDE), and host-side clients (AlphaFold DB, FreeSASA, ReGlyco). AlphaFold 3 is retired in favour of ESMFold2/OpenDDE.
author: ProtForge contributors
exampleQueries: Which protein design tools do you have, and which do I use for a binder against PDB 1ABC?
What is the structure prediction path here — ESMFold2 or OpenDDE?
Detect the binding pockets of PDB 2B7D
Design a binder backbone against hotspots A71,A74,A75 with RFdiffusion
Design a sequence for that backbone with ProteinMPNN
Dock SMILES CCO into receptor 1ABC with box centre 12.3 4.5 8.1
Run a 5000-step GROMACS MD on PDB 1CRN
Download the public AlphaFold DB model for UniProt P69905 and report its pLDDT
Check whether my designed binder clashes with the glycans on this glycoprotein
